## Purpose
`/login`: user sign-in. On success it goes to the safe `next` path.

## Responsibilities
`LoginPage`:
- someone already signed in goes straight through;
- the form posts `authApi.login`, refreshes `authApi.session` and navigates to `safeNext(next)`;
- uses the `AuthParts` layout.

Titled "Sign in — Agentic AI Design Patterns".

## Key elements
`LoginPage`.

## Control flow
A form submit.

## Data, state and side effects
The session cookie (server-side).

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/auth/login`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- The server's lockout and rate limit messages are shown.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **An unknown email and a wrong password look the same,** by server design.

## How to rebuild this file
As described.
